title: What If Every Clock Stopped at the Same Second?
title_it: E se tutti gli orologi del mondo si fermassero nello stesso secondo?
idea: At 3:00 am every clock on Earth stops, and the first thing to break isn't time but your map: GPS is a ring of atomic clocks, a millionth of a second off puts you 300 meters away, so every blue dot freezes, then the phone towers drop. But time never stopped, only our way of counting it: the Sun still rises, the stars still turn, and the fox with the lantern still finds its way home.
hook: What if every clock in the world stopped at the same second?
caption: What if every clock in the world stopped at 3:00:00 tonight? ⏱️ The first thing to break wouldn't be time. It would be your map. GPS is really a ring of atomic clocks in the sky, and a millionth of a second off puts you 300 meters away. 🦊🏮
first_comment: Fun fact: light travels about 300 meters in one millionth of a second. That's why GPS needs atomic clocks. ⏱️🦊
